response.sql: WITH item_town AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_avg AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item_town GROUP BY town_city), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM town_avg) SELECT t.town_city, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_above_average FROM town_avg t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio
